name: Launch in dark theme
description: Start Ultralight with dark chrome, toolbars, and tabs by default.

name: Dark theme excluded sites
description: List of URL patterns where dark theme should NOT be applied (one pattern per line). Browser internal pages are automatically excluded.

name: Vibrant window theme
description: Apply a subtle color wash to the window frame for a livelier finish.

name: Transparent toolbar
description: Blend the toolbar into page content with a translucent, glass-like surface.

name: Compact tabs
description: Reduce tab height and spacing so more tabs stay visible without scrolling.

name: Reduce motion effects
description: Limit animated transitions and parallax flourishes for a calmer experience.

name: High contrast UI
description: Boost contrast for overlays, menus, and dialogs to improve readability.

name: Enable caret browsing
description: Navigate web pages using keyboard cursor like in a text editor.

name: Enable ad blocking
description: Filter network requests using bundled block lists to hide intrusive ads.

name: Log blocked requests
description: Write each blocked network request to the console for debugging rules.

name: Clear history on exit
description: Remove browsing history when Ultralight closes and skip saving new visits.

name: Enable JavaScript
description: Allow websites to run JavaScript code for interactive features and dynamic content.

name: Enable web security
description: Enforce same-origin policy and other web security restrictions.

name: Block third-party cookies
description: Prevent websites from setting cookies that track you across different sites.

name: Send Do Not Track header
description: Request that websites not track your browsing activity.

name: Use custom user agent
description: When enabled, send a user agent string that you specify instead of the automatic Chromium-like default.

name: Show address bar suggestions
description: Surface history matches and popular sites while typing in the address bar.

name: Show favicons in suggestions
description: Display site icons next to suggestion rows whenever an icon is available.

name: Show download badge
description: Highlight the toolbar downloads button whenever transfers are active.

name: Open downloads panel automatically
description: Pop open the quick downloads overlay as soon as a new download begins.

name: Ask where to save downloads
description: Show a file picker dialog for each download instead of using default location.

name: Smooth scrolling
description: Animate scrolling. Off by default: this is implemented with scroll-behavior:smooth, which animates the document scroller on every wheel tick and also turns scrollIntoView() and in-page anchor jumps into animations.

name: Hardware acceleration
description: Use GPU to accelerate graphics rendering for better performance.

name: Enable local storage
description: Allow websites to store data locally for offline functionality.

name: Enable database storage
description: Allow websites to use IndexedDB and Web SQL for data storage.

name: Low-RAM mode
description: Watch the process working set and reclaim memory from background tabs when it grows past your budget.

name: Memory budget (MB)
description: Working-set budget in megabytes. Once usage stays above it for a few seconds, low-RAM mode kicks in.

name: Enable DRM WebView
description: Automatically switch DRM-protected sites to a native OS WebView with Widevine support.

name: Media Fallback
description: Open known video sites (YouTube, Vimeo, Twitch...) in the native OS WebView. The bundled engine ships no video codecs, so playback shows an empty box otherwise.

name: Enable remote inspector
description: Allow remote debugging via Chrome DevTools Protocol.

name: Show performance overlay
description: Display FPS counter and rendering statistics on screen.

name: Restore previous session
description: Reopen tabs from your last browsing session when starting the browser.

name: Enable crash recovery
description: Continuously save session state so tabs can be restored after crashes or unexpected closures (ALT+F4).
